summary: SOS Limited filed a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) containing a statement regarding unusual market activity in its securities on September 23, 2026, issued under Section 202.03 of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. Following management inquiries, the company states it is unaware of any undisclosed information or business development that would account for the trading activity. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing mechanism is disclosed. This is a routine disclosure response, not a special situation; watch for subsequent filings or exchange inquiries.
